description:
## Summary
- Add support for using an external PostgreSQL database with the `mcp-stack` chart
- Compatible with CloudNativePG and managed database services

## Credits
Based on PR #2056 by @Aurelian-Shuttleworth. Thank you for the contribution!

## Changes
- **Values Schema**: Added `postgres.external` configuration block
- **Gateway Deployment**: Dynamic resolution of POSTGRES_* env vars from external secret
- **PgBouncer**: External postgres connection support
- **Migration Job**: External postgres connection support
- **Helper**: Updated `postgresSecretName` to resolve external vs internal secrets

## Additional Fixes (during review)
- Create secret from direct values when `existingSecret` not provided
- Gate all internal postgres resources when external is enabled (Secret, Service, PVC, ConfigMap)
- Disable postgres upgrade jobs when external is enabled (can't upgrade external DB)
- Update NOTES.txt to show external postgres info

## Configuration
```yaml
# Using existing secret (CloudNativePG)
postgres:
  enabled: false
  external:
    enabled: true
    existingSecret: "my-db-secret"

# Using direct values
postgres:
  enabled: false
  external:
    enabled: true
    host: "db.example.com"
    port: 5432
    database: "mydb"
    user: "myuser"
    password: "mypassword"
```

Closes #2052

commits.message:
fix(chart): create secret for external postgres when existingSecret not provided

When using postgres.external.enabled=true without specifying an
existingSecret, the chart now creates a secret from the direct values
(host, port, database, user, password) provided in values.yaml.

This fixes a bug where the chart would reference a non-existent secret
when users provided direct values for external postgres configuration.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(chart): prevent internal postgres resources when external is enabled

When postgres.external.enabled=true, all internal postgres resources
(Secret, Service, PVC, ConfigMap) are now properly excluded:

- secret-postgres.yaml: Don't create internal secret when external enabled
- service-postgres.yaml: Don't create service when external enabled
- postgres-pvc.yaml: Don't create PVC when external enabled
- configmap-postgres.yaml: Don't create configmap when external enabled

This fixes two issues:
1. High: Internal secret could overwrite external existingSecret name
2. Medium: Orphan Service/PVC created when using external database

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(chart): disable postgres upgrade jobs and update NOTES for external postgres

- job-postgres-backup.yaml: Skip when external postgres enabled (can't
  upgrade external DB through this chart)
- job-postgres-migration-check.yaml: Skip when external postgres enabled
- NOTES.txt: Show external postgres info when external is enabled,
  hide internal postgres commands that don't apply

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
